Large batched documentation reads were truncated; own-score guide and renderer setup instructions were visible. Subsequent reads use narrower ranges.
Initial demo readiness exited 1 for absent py65, renderer and native exporter; all three repaired using documented core setup.
Initial uv request exited 2 after sandbox DNS failure; authorized network escalation succeeded with fresh project-local cache.

uv initially selected installed Miniconda Python 3.10.13; subsequent installs explicitly selected the existing /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 (3.15.0). No Miniconda files or packages were inspected or reused.

friction.detail: Automatic approval review initially rejected the literal anonymous header as a credential transmission. No request executed on that rejected attempt.
Credential-free renderer download exited 56 with HTTP 401.

Verified local guide explicitly identifies QQ== as public anonymous access and decoded the fixed literal to A. Re-review approved the documented non-secret request; pinned checksum passed. No private/user credentials were read or transmitted.
score readiness exited 1 only for absent clone-local headless VICE and C64 ROMs; Mido and all core demo checks passed. Desktop GTK VICE was found separately and not run.

interventions: Created task-local command runner with process deadlines and retained logs.
Renderer bottle will use clone-local .local/downloads instead of shared /private/tmp filename in guide; content/hash unchanged.
Used explicit system Python for both uv target installations.
Used approved network access after sandbox DNS failure.
Established anonymous GHCR marker is non-secret before retrying the rejected download.
Kept the comparison cache and requested evidence protected during automated cleanup; cleanup logging was moved to .local to avoid a concurrent writer in build.

nativeArticulationLimits.basis: SID-Wizard 1.97 player.asm STRTSND/SETWFR1 and tempo-1 FASTSPEEDBIND
nativeArticulationLimits.effect: First frame initializes only frequency high byte and the chosen frame1 waveform; full frequency and table body follow on the next tick. Tempo 1 bypasses hard restart; adjacent notes without a gate-off cell do not retrigger the envelope.

recipeStages.scope: All five stages fresh on first run; all five reused on unchanged repeat within this task. No earlier cache was reused.
recipeStages.abOrder: A: plain triangle reduced-score control; 0.5-second gap; B: configured SID palette. Same reduced notes and timing, original amplitudes; control is not a full-polyphonic source performance.
